links.outcome: Effect of DECIDE/ASK/DEFER versus DECIDE/ABSTAIN on erroneous and correct autonomous decisions
links.effect: The three-action policy rescued some erroneous autonomous decisions but also removed some correct ones; models disagreed on action in 137 of 200 states.
links.quote: Its matched DECIDE/ABSTAIN baseline further reveals a safety autonomy tradeoff: the three action policy rescues some erroneous autonomous decisions but also removes some correct autonomous deci sions.

screen.reason: Empirical benchmark evaluating LLM diagnostic decision-making under incomplete evidence, explicitly comparing a DECIDE/ASK/DEFER safeguard framework against a standard DECIDE/ABSTAIN baseline.

primary.practice: three-action policy (decide/ask/defer triage vs binary decide/abstain)
